blink.provenance: NASA IRSA SPHEREx Data Standard Service
blink.tap_query_executed: SELECT 'https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/' || a.uri || '?center=133.7951,-7.2451d&size=0.0833' AS uri, p.time_bounds_lower, p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_upper, p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 133.7951, -7.2451), p.poly) ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
